newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China aviation official to head Air Macau -- paper.
newsitem.headline: China aviation official to head Air Macau -- paper.

text.p: A senior official of China's aviation regulator will take over as chief executive of Air Macau, flag carrier of the Portuguese-run enclave bordering southern China, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Monday.
The South China Morning Post reported that Li Ke Li, an official with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), would take his post at the airline no later than early February.
Air Macau is 51 percent held by CAAC unit China National Aviation Corp's Air China.
He replaces Ng Kian-wah, who returned to Singapore Airlines after a year and a half with Air Macau, the Post said.
Air Macau officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
